newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek May private construction rises 5.0 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Greek May private construction rises 5.0 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Greece's May index of private construction activity rose 5.0 percent from a year ago, the National Statistics Service (NSS) said.
The index, using construction volume in cubic metres based on the number of issued buildng permits, was up 13.4 percent in April year-on-year.
"In May, construction volume based on the number of building permits nationwide reached 5.344 million cubic metres against 5.09 million in May 1996, an increase of 5.0 percent," NSS said.
In the first five months, private construction activity rose 4.8 percent compared to the same period a year earlier.

Building activity fell 1.1 percent in the Attica region but rose 7.1 percent in the rest of the country. It was up 10.7 percent in the Aegean islands, up 14.2 percent in Macedonia and 2.1 percent in Thrace.
